Must be used whenever the aircraft is in motion at night.
Aerobatics, short breaks, stalls, and formation flights are prohibited at night.
Touch and go’s to uncontrolled airfields may be conducted provided they have night lighting and a wildlife mitigation pass is conducted prior to operations.

Taxiway Lighting
Blue.
Green.
Three steady yellow lights at holding points.
Series of lights before the runway to aid in aligning with the runway:
Often include flashing lights (sequenced flashers or "the rabbit").
Visual Glide Slope Indicators
Four lights, more precise:
red lights across a taxiway—must not be crossed unless ATC clears and lights are off.
red/White lights indicating if above, below, or on glidepath.
For taxi only. Use ashore except when directed by taxi signalman.
